title: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Fire

sources.title: Fireball
markers: | description = Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for {{DamageText|8d6|Fire}} damage.

summary: Until Long Rest, gain Fire resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Fireball.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain Fire resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Fireball.
fields.Acquisition: Trade brass, gold or red dragonborn blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Fireball: Action. At up to 60 ft, creatures in a 13 ft radius take 8d6 Fire, Dexterity save for half.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
